text: This case adds three ways for people to steer what gets copied: filter rules that include or exclude files, handling of relative paths, and the option to read the list of files to transfer from a file. Those are standard parts of the original tool's interface, so xs-rs cannot match it feature for feature until they behave the same way, byte for byte. On the one comparison measured so far, xs-rs takes about 1.54 times as long as the original in the noop scenario, while the real-projects result is still pending — so closing gaps like this is what puts the port on equal footing before the speed work can mean anything.
